subcategory_text: The organization’s role(s) in the data processing ecosystem are identified and communicated.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-2 (Information Security Program Leadership), PM-11 (Information Security Governance)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.1 (Policies for information security)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.OC-01 (organisational mission understood)
implementation_examples: Identify and document the organisation's role(s) in the data processing ecosystem (e.g., controller, processor, joint controller, sub-processor)
Communicate the role(s) internally and externally so that contractual, technical, and organisational measures align with the role
Re-validate the assigned role when processing relationships change (acquisition, divestiture, new product line)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the organisation's role(s) in the data processing ecosystem are identified
Determine whether the assigned roles are communicated to internal and external stakeholders
Determine whether role changes trigger a documented review
Determine whether contractual measures reflect the organisation's role
